| 2007 | 589 | 11 |
| Later years | 5,259 | 113 |

These purchase commitments include those required for regulated operations. Dominion recovers the costs of those pur- chases through regulated rates. The natural gas purchase com- mitments of dominion 's field services operations are also included, net of related sales commitments.
